what_happened: The job "Route all test stand-in writes through one child-process helper" (a follow-up to the ETXTBSY fix) ended failed at admission. Admission refused the change because crates/athena-testkit/Cargo.toml is a governance file (its [lints] tables). A job may change such a file only if the accepted reading lists it as a deliverable and names it in an acceptance criterion, and this reading did not. No acceptance criterion was judged unmet and no check failed. The job was stopped before any work started.
failure: the model chose class "20261016-... ", which is not in the registry
